title: OpenSkiTime Live API
description: Messages of the OpenSkiTime Live API, version 1. New properties, new status values and new messages can be added at any time: readers ignore what they do not know. A property is listed as required when the server always sends it.

Race.title: Race
Race.description: One published race in the list of races.

sessionId.description: The race on this server. A race published again can get a new ID.

discipline.description: Discipline code as the organizer entered it, for example SL or GS.

codex.description: Race codex; empty when the race has none.

paused.description: The organizer has stopped publishing for now.

State.title: State
State.description: The complete published state of one race.

version.description: The publisher's own counter. Do not use it to detect or order changes: pausing does not increment it.

currentRun.description: Number of the run being timed.

paused.description: The organizer has stopped publishing for now.

discipline.description: Discipline code as the organizer entered it, for example SL or GS.

codex.description: Race codex; empty when the race has none.

intermediateCount.description: Number of intermediate timing points on the course.

runCount.description: Number of runs in the race, or 0 when the publisher does not tell.

bib.description: Unique in the race. Result rows and start orders refer to it.

fisCode.description: FIS or national federation code of the competitor; can be empty.

category.description: Class of the competitor, for example N10. Empty in a race without classes.

listCreatedAt.description: When the start list of the run was created.

results.description: One row per bib. The order of the rows is not the ranking; use rank.

forerunners.description: Null when the run has no forerunners.

Result.title: Result
Result.description: The result row of one competitor in one run. Times are integers in hundredths of a second: 5012 is 50.12 seconds. In a race with classes, rank and difference (and their totals) are those within the class.

hundredths.description: Run time. Use it only when the status is Finished.

rank.description: Rank in the run. Equal times share a rank.

difference.description: Gap to the best time of the run.

at.description: Time of the latest impulse or correction of the row.

startedAt.description: Start time, for a running clock.

startSourceTicks.description: Diagnostic source timestamp of the timing device in 100 ns units, as a decimal string. Do not calculate results from it.

intermediates.description: Intermediate times so far; null or empty when there are none.

totalHundredths.description: Combined time of all runs so far, from Run 2 on. Null without a finished time in every run so far.

number.description: Timing point, 1 is the first one after the start.

hundredths.description: Time from the start in hundredths of a second.

sourceTicks.description: Diagnostic source timestamp, as in Result.

Forerunner.title: Forerunner
Forerunner.description: Progress of a forerunner. A forerunner never has a time.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Ready: has not started. OnCourse: started. Finished: has a valid time. DNS: did not start. DNF: did not finish. DSQ: disqualified. NPS: not permitted to start. Review: the timing crew is checking the times; not a result yet.

SyncMessage.title: Sync
SyncMessage.description: SignalR message Sync: the complete state of the race, or why there is none.

generation.description: Identifier of this history of the race on the server; null unless Live. Compare only for equality.

revision.description: Increases by one with every change of the same generation; 0 unless Live.

DeltaMessage.title: Delta
DeltaMessage.description: SignalR message Delta: one change. It applies only to revision baseRevision of the same generation, and only as a whole.

results.description: Complete rows. Each one replaces the row with the same bib, or is new.

order.description: Bibs of all rows in their new order. When absent, rows keep their places and new rows follow in the order of results.

forerunners.description: The complete new list. When absent, the forerunners did not change.

BeaconMessage.title: Beacon
BeaconMessage.description: SignalR message Beacon, about every 30 seconds: what a reader that missed nothing has now.

SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus
SessionStatus.description: Live: the server has the state. Deleted: the organizer deleted the race. Awaiting: the server has no state now (not published yet, not restored after a server restart, or an unknown ID).
